user.title: Set up a trip
user.description:
One page, three fields. For **start** and **destination** you can either type an **address** or pick an **entity** (person, zone, device tracker, sensor with coordinates). Entities are resolved to their current coordinates on every request.

Requires the **Travel Time** add-on to be installed and running.

data_description.name: Name of the trip, for example "Commute".
data_description.start: Type an address or pick an entity.
data_description.end: Type an address or pick an entity.
data_description.scan_interval: 0 = only when the button is pressed. Otherwise refresh every X minutes.
